sections.title: Arcade Classics, Btown Edition
sections.description: 18 games you already know how to play, rebuilt for your phone with a Burlington twist. New!

sections.title: Action & Arcade
sections.description: Quick reflexes, high scores, and Burlington-sized chaos.

sections.title: Daily Puzzles & Quizzes
sections.description: Words, trivia, local knowledge, and fresh reasons to come back.

sections.title: Board & Card Classics
sections.description: Familiar favorites rebuilt with a Vermont twist. Solo vs the bot, pass the phone, or play online — bot wins make the leaderboard.

sections.title: Party & Community
sections.description: Pass the phone, share a laugh, or let the town decide.

sections.title: Local Challenges & Stories
sections.description: Take the arcade into Burlington, or dig into the Brief.

sections.title: Party Night
sections.description: Live games for a whole room — everyone scans a QR code, phones stay mostly pocketed, and the reveals land together on a big screen (or read aloud by whoever's hosting). Built for Btown Brief meetups and mixers — or your own living room. Anyone can host, free, no accounts.

games.boardHint: Sink the Harbormaster's fleet in the fewest shots — a perfect 17-shot hunt scores 84.

_comment_hidden: Hidden Nov 16, 2026 for low traffic (0-3 visits Aug-Nov). They stay playable at their URLs but are off the hub, search and leaderboards. To bring one back, move its entry from 'hidden' into 'games'.

hidden.name: Front Porch Dominoes
hidden.pitch: Draw dominoes under the string lights — first to 100 wins the porch. Solo vs Porch Swing Pete, or 2–4 players.
hidden.boardHint: Biggest points margin — 👀 Neighbor wins outrank 🪑 Porch Swing Pete wins.

hidden.name: North Star Hop
hidden.pitch: Hop your marbles across the star under the northern lights — solo vs Polaris, or 2–4 players.
hidden.boardHint: Fewest hops to bring every marble home — 🧭 Navigator wins outrank ⭐ Polaris wins.

hidden.name: Maple Mancala
hidden.pitch: Sow maple candies bucket to bucket and capture the sweetest side of the plank.
hidden.boardHint: Sweetest store margin — 🔥 Sugarmaker wins outrank 🌱 Sap Run wins.

hidden.name: Kings Corner
hidden.pitch: Kings to the corners: shed your hand around City Hall Park before the bot does.
hidden.boardHint: Shed your hand in the fewest turns to outdeal the Mayor.

hidden.name: Btown Cribbage
hidden.pitch: Full cribbage on the Long Trail peg board — the app does all the counting.
hidden.boardHint: Beat Champ by the most points — a skunk scores 31+.

hidden.name: Btown Crossings
hidden.pitch: Our own word-tile board: Church Street doubles your word, the Waterfront triples a letter.
hidden.boardHint: Your highest winning score against SKIP.

hidden.name: Caption This
hidden.pitch: BTown's weekly caption contest: swipe on the funniest, or write your own.

hidden.name: Maples to Maples
hidden.pitch: The weekly party game: one prompt, your best answer, the town votes.

modes.title: On a screen
modes.blurb: Cabinets, puzzles and card games. Play right here, right now.

modes.title: Out in Burlington
modes.blurb: Put the phone in your pocket and go somewhere. These need real streets.

_comment_where: A game with "where": "out" appears under Out in Burlington; everything else defaults to the screen side. Scavenger hunts go here — add the game as normal and give it "where": "out". Nothing else needs to change.
